title: Go-live cutover for in-flight spreadsheet sign-ups is unresolved and has no ticket; WAGR-51 removes the only manual create path

jira.quote: records must originate ONLY from the Study Link Click automation (BUILD-04 / SLC async flow).

So, are we saying like we're going to hold off on this like fully going live until all those pieces that are in like including like the later / Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. / Kobi Kunasekaran: phases / Emily Vandenberg: ... the gap and running two parallel systems um we just don't feel like we could get it over the line with your rep reps from an adoption perspective ...

what_differs: On 7/15 Emily said that sign-ups started in the spreadsheet will appear net new in Salesforce at cutover, and that this cutover needs planning. Kobi suggested a manual rep path. No later meeting answered it. No ticket holds a cutover plan (WAGR-125 refers to a 'migration cutover checklist' that does not exist as a ticket). WAGR-51 (Ready) removes rep Create on Sign-Up.
suggested_action: Create a cutover-plan ticket under WAGR-19. It should cover how in-flight spreadsheet sign-ups enter Salesforce (Ops/admin create path or a final delta import, since WAGR-51 blocks reps), the spreadsheet freeze date, and the logo and checklist items WAGR-125 refers to. Confirm the approach with Emily.
